<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> Both Houses faced repeated adjournments due to intense protests between the NDA and INDIA bloc, fueled by clashes over political rhetoric, including a controversial &quot;lungiwala&quot; remark, and mutual accusations of accountability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQSXlWQ3lWQnhQZTF6RkthN2hrVWRHc2xyVER0Wnptbk1mbEV5WHgyWFFWak5rdVYxMl9CbHhFNVRoVnRscWdyWmVHenctYXVNUTBmN3hOSTZYTlowODYyMnR3NFhiNFRGWXJxSm9QZkwyWVdDc1MwMWlGVFVHcHd0WjBBNE91YXVnVDlkb25PUUZVanpKR20wam9BaWdEMEZWWk8zckZ3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Inquiry report tabled:</strong> The Justice Yashwant Varma inquiry report was formally tabled in both Houses of Parliament, with findings indicating no evidence of conspiracy in the cash-related allegations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQdktmTVRaUTJDOTYyNzJsOEVzVnhITGV3VVpKelRQaWR3VWk0dF82T3R0SFR0T2g1ZGJTeC1ncWFReGh4TnQ2VkFQSmVpUDdzOTRQOWN4cGpBSFloT0g4S1BVLWpWcDVmcm4wQXdYR296cE51VFB4RXpvZ3dUUUtqMl9VWks5X0ZfVHM3MzNVbkNoR3c4QU56VmdadkJ5cUhDWmNpWHlydjVhazNocXRrM0cwS3hTaERXVC1obkNJNjlxWXc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>State-level resolutions:</strong> Tamil Nadu and political leader Vijay have moved separate resolutions seeking to freeze the Lok Sabha strength at 543 seats, reflecting growing regional concerns over potential parliamentary seat reapportionment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPYWs3SFprZDdPUVVORk9iOGRNN1h0RWFpUWFPZjZjWHNYZ3BSaHVZeXZ6LXJfeVc3a01jR1dTV0JUWmJRU01sVVB4eE0wRXUyTm1XOHZlak1SQk9ncFpmeFgyVEtXN0puTGFEcGlRa1dlck1faWM5NjVKdTVNLWktbHJWWFdqc2pIUThhcHJtNTJWUzdBM2pTV2xoZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative progress:</strong> Parliament passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026, amid an opposition walkout, while the Lok Sabha also cleared the NCDC Bill and a bill to officially rename Kerala to &quot;Keralam.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxNTXh5UTEwdlBSWXBTR3BnSUJjQkk3TGZlLTBtUjFjc1JwaURpSmF5em9GZ0RISWpHdkFqenhybVpkd3Z1aTNRMUI4NE1VcDljaC1HWjNseHBiS1dWNEpKYmV6M3VlSFpvTHVndlhDTXd0c200OE90dXJHeVVwdHJ4Q1hIV0t6eXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>FCRA review:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed a motion to refer the FCRA Amendment Bill 2026 to a Joint Parliamentary Committee following opposition demands for the bill&#x27;s withdrawal.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
